_contract.spec_checksum: sha256 of artifacts/model_spec.md at the time the results were produced
_contract.environment: interpreter and key dependency versions, e.g. 'python 3.12.3; numpy 2.1.0; scipy 1.14.0'
_contract.model_deviations: workspace-relative path, or null when nothing deviated
notes: 每个子问题至少一个 code、一个 results、一个 figures 条目，全部为工作区相对路径。
seed 为 null 表示该子问题确定性求解，不使用随机数。
Stage 2 预检会校验 run_id、input_fingerprint、spec_checksum 与声明文件是否存在。
启用 quality_contract_version=1.0 的工作区还会校验质量契约哈希、逐问 id 对齐和每问至少一个 primary 指标。
_contract.quality_contract_checksum: sha256 of artifacts/quality_contract.json at the time the results were produced
_contract.result_registry: workspace-relative path to the machine-readable headline result registry
